bridge.title: Four things I noticed

beats.title: 40,000 views on one video. The top tier is $160 a month.
beats.text: Your “Moon Boys” video passed 40,000 views in its first day and a half, and SWJ has 784 reviews at 4.6 stars. But the highest thing anyone can buy is the $160 monthly tier, cancel anytime.

beats.title: Your members already want more of you.
beats.text: 15 live sessions a week, Chart GOAT University, a VIP Discord and eight uploads in three days. The most serious members would pay to have you look at their trades, not just watch yours.

beats.title: Everyone gets the same thing, month by month.
beats.text: Every member is on a monthly plan they can cancel any time, and there's no tier where you work with someone directly. The ones who'd stay longest and pay most leave the same way as everyone else.

beats.title: “I already do 15 sessions a week.” This is fewer people.
beats.text: The mentorship isn't more sessions. It's a small group whose own charts you review, chosen through an application. Fewer people, more depth, and members who stay.
beats.quote: “breaking down complicated topics into easy to digest videos for new traders.”

bridge.closing: So instead of explaining it, I built it. The page, the application, the emails and the ads, all below.

qualification.title: Apply for the Chart GOAT mentorship

questions.q: How long have you been trading?
What's the biggest thing holding your trading back right now?
Can you trade or review charts at least 3 days a week?
Do you only trade money you can afford to lose?
If you're accepted, are you ready to invest in the mentorship now?

notFit.title: Thank you for being honest.
notFit.body: Right now the mentorship isn't the right next step for you. Start with Josh's free videos or the SWJ community, and apply again when you're ready.

finalCta.title: Ready to read the chart on your own?

preCallEmails.subject: You're booked: here's what happens next
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is booked for {{call_time}}. The link is in your calendar invite.

Before we talk:
1. Keep the time free.
2. Have a few recent trades ready, with your levels and why you took them.

One note: nobody on my team will ever ask you to pay through a DM. Payments only happen through the official links from this email address.

Talk soon,
Josh

preCallEmails.subject: Levels, breakouts, risk rules
preCallEmails.previewText: Why a plan beats one more tip
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Most traders know the rules and still break them, because nobody looks at their trades.

The mentorship is where I do exactly that.

On the call we'll look at where you are today.

Josh

preCallEmails.subject: "I'm already in SWJ"
preCallEmails.previewText: Then this is the next step
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Great, then you know how I trade.

The mentorship is a small group where I review your own charts every week, on top of everything in SWJ.

If you're not sure you need it, ask on the call. We'll tell you honestly.

Josh

preCallEmails.subject: What we'll cover on the call
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

The call takes about 30 minutes:

1. Where you are now and what you've tried.
2. Where you want to be in a year.
3. How the program works, what it costs, and whether it fits you.

If it isn't a fit, we'll tell you. No pressure either way.

Josh

preCallEmails.subject: Tomorrow: your call with Josh's team
preCallEmails.body:

Quick reminder: your call is tomorrow at {{call_time}}.

If the time doesn't work anymore, reschedule with the link in your invite so someone else can take the slot.

See you tomorrow,
Josh
